messages:
Alex: Quick Q — Vendor asks for a recommended pricing grid and reserve/spot bridge we want them to publish for Marketplace onboarding. Thinking 3 buckets (commit-heavy, mixed, ephemeral). Thoughts?
Priya: I like 3 buckets. we should be explicit about commit lengths + crediting. e.g., 1m/3m/12m windows and % credit back on early termination.
Mateo: Also include an eviction multiplier for spot to capture preemption risk (default 1.8x). makes cost-modeling easier for customers.
Jing: +1 on eviction multiplier. we should give a sample CSV spec so partners can drop numbers in. can we standardize column names?
Alex: Proposed CSV columns: vendor, region, sku, commit_tenor_days, commit_price_per_hour_usd, spot_price_per_hour_usd, eviction_multiplier, early_term_credit_pct, min_capacity_gpus
Priya: That looks good. can you add a column for billed_gpu_type (vram/arch) and a notes column for burst windows?
Alex: Updated sample below:
```
vendor,region,sku,billed_gpu_type,commit_tenor_days,commit_price_per_hour_usd,spot_price_per_hour_usd,eviction_multiplier,early_term_credit_pct,min_capacity_gpus,notes
CoreWave,us-west,core-a40,40GB-A40,30,1.10,0.30,1.8,0.25,4,weekday-burst-8-6
CoreWave,us-west,core-a40,40GB-A40,365,0.72,0.30,1.6,0.40,16,preferred-reserved
```
Mateo: Nice. For modeling let's also ask for typical lead time for fulfilling reserve requests and a degradation curve (availability% by hour-of-day).
Jing: Right. ask partners for SLA tiers and latency premiums if they offer pinned hardware vs pooled. that affects our pricing recommendation for Dedicated customers.
Priya: On the crediting side: propose linear credit over remaining term capped at 75% of remaining commit value. share that as our default fallback.
Alex: Operational ask to partner: can you provide sample monthly invoice lines aligned to the CSV so our billing ingest maps cleanly? prefer newline-delimited JSON or CSV samples.
supply-bot: Automated reply: Received request 1712345678. Please attach CSV to the vendor onboarding ticket (VND-4329). ETA for partner response: 3-5 business days.
Mateo: Next steps: Alex to send CSV template + short doc with definitions; Priya to draft crediting policy text; Jing to request availability curves and latency premium tiers from partners.
Alex: I'll ping vendor contact and drop the template into VND-4329 today. tagging @Priya @Jing for review before send. :rocket:
Priya: I'll have the crediting draft by EOD tomorrow.
Jing: I'll draft the availability request and sample heatmap visualization we want partners to fill.
Alex: Perfect. If partner pushes back on commit tenors, we can accept custom tenors but require explicit eviction + credit numbers.
Mateo: Agreed. also let's capture a one-off onboarding uplift (e.g., 5% on price) to cover integration and egress frictions — we can waive later if volume hits thresholds.
Alex: Good call. I'll include a line for "onboarding_uplift_pct" in the template.
Priya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after vendor responds.
